newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna bourse to allow remote members - finmin.
newsitem.headline: Vienna bourse to allow remote members - finmin.

text.p: The Vienna bourse, aware it needs to drum up new business, will in future allow market makers to trade on its derivatives market without the need for membership, the finance ministry said on Thursday.

Wolfgang Ruttenstorfer, state secretary at the finance ministry, told journalists an amendment of the stock exchange law in autumn would allow the participation of remote members on the Austrian Futures and Options Exchange (OeTOB).
However, Ruttenstorfer added that the existing law should be interpreted by the finance ministry in a way that would allow remote trading immediately without the need for a seat on the exchange.
The higher amount of market participants "would make transaction costs more competitive -- and only that brings prices down," Ruttenstorfer said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
